# QK Coldstores

> Temperature-controlled cold storage, blast freezing, and logistics in Grantham, Lincolnshire.

QK Cold Stores (Marston) Ltd operates a BRC-accredited cold storage facility in Marston, Grantham, serving the East Midlands and UK food manufacturing sector.
